timeline.summary: The Golgari create a sinkhole that topples and shatters Zobor, also destroying the Tower of Thismi and damaging the Centerfort and Rokiric Pavilion.
timeline.quote: The Golgari created a massive sinkhole beneath him, causing the titan to topple and shatter across the surface of the mountain.
